identityDescription: Approved Silent skin identity sheet: original anime heroine in a green hood, acid-green slit-pupil eyes, vial bandolier, jade snake ring, two poison daggers (generated, not committed)
identityCues: a tall slender original anime heroine with a deep green hood and long cloak, narrow face with a small pointed chin, large flat acid-green slit-pupil eyes with one crisp white highlight, cream scarf, black bodysuit, wrapped boots, a bandolier of tiny poison vials with glass stoppers, a jade snake ring on one finger, and two poison daggers (one reverse grip).
palette: deep jade and forest greens, black and bone white, acid-green accents; saturated cloudless sky or one flat hot colour panel behind her; no red, no bronze.

styleReferences.description: Monogatari series second-season key art: extreme low camera angle, cloudless cobalt sky, white geometric masts, stacked diagonal figures (copyrighted, not committed)
Monogatari series close-up frame: huge flat eyes with crisp highlights, shard-like flat hair, fine linework, painted sea and cloud backdrop (copyrighted, not committed)
Monogatari series group frame: hard diagonal shadow cuts, cracked grey wall with one hot flat colour panel, geometric clutter, long limbs (copyrighted, not committed)

slayer_caltrops.name: Caltrops
slayer_caltrops.scene: She crouches low and flicks a handful of small iron caltrop stars across a stone floor toward the camera, seen from a high angle, the spikes scattering in a flat spiral, one hard diagonal shadow cut across the floor.

slayer_endless_agony.name: Endless Agony
slayer_endless_agony.scene: Low camera angle: she thrusts a reverse-grip dagger toward the lens again and again, three thin repeated motion arcs of the same blade stacked on a diagonal, head tilted, a flat hot panel colour behind her.

slayer_eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
slayer_eviscerate.scene: She opens her hand and lets a fan of discarded playing cards fall away, each card leaving one thin white slash line in the air, a symmetric emblem composition with her calm face centred above.

slayer_glass_knife.name: Glass Knife
slayer_glass_knife.scene: Close low-angle shot of her thrusting a clear glass dagger, the blade transparent pale green with a long crack down its centre and a few shards flying off, her hooded face tilted behind it.

slayer_heel_hook.name: Heel Hook
slayer_heel_hook.scene: A long leg sweeps in a low arc as she hooks an enemy silhouette's ankle with her heel, the foe toppling backwards, seen side-on from a high angle, hard diagonal shadow polygons on the floor.

slayer_nightmare.name: Nightmare
slayer_nightmare.scene: She sits calm and cross-legged while a huge ghostly pale-green double of herself leans over her from behind like a dream, the double holding a floating card, tilted heads, shadow-cut staging.

slayer_phantasmal_killer.name: Phantasmal Killer
slayer_phantasmal_killer.scene: A pale ghostly green copy of her rises behind her with both daggers lifted, she stands in the foreground deadpan, symmetric emblem composition with calm margins.

strike_silent.name: Strike
strike_silent.scene: A clean single dagger strike: she lunges forward in profile with one poison dagger slashing a bright diagonal line across the frame, low camera angle under a cloudless saturated sky, hood tilting.

defend_silent.name: Defend
defend_silent.scene: She crosses both poison daggers in front of her chest in a guard, head tilted, cloak flaring, hard diagonal shadow behind her and one flat panel of colour.

neutralize.name: Neutralize
neutralize.scene: She throws a dagger that pins an enemy silhouette's sleeve to a cracked wall, a small green gas wisp rising from the wound-free sleeve, she stands relaxed with a pointed finger.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.scene: She crouches and pulls her cloak around herself while flicking one card away with two fingers, a smoke vial dropping, low angle, deep shadow cut.

dagger_throw.name: Dagger Throw
dagger_throw.scene: A side-on throw: her arm fully extended after releasing a dagger that streaks toward the right edge with three thin speed lines, long limbs, flat sky.

prepared.name: Prepared
prepared.scene: High angle looking straight down: she kneels over a cloth laid with daggers and glass vials in neat rows, checking one dagger, her hood and scarf making simple shapes.

riddle_with_holes.name: Riddle with Holes
riddle_with_holes.scene: Five thrown daggers fan out across the frame and pin a silhouetted target, tiny bright round holes of light riddling it, she stands at the left edge with her arm still extended.

dash.name: Dash
dash.scene: She dashes forward in a very low long lunge across the frame, cloak streaming behind, dagger trailing, flat horizontal speed bands, low camera angle.

die_die_die.name: Die Die Die
die_die_die.scene: Seen from a high angle she spins gracefully on one foot with both arms stretched out, a ring of many small throwing knives fanning outward from her hands in a flat spiral toward the walls of an empty courtyard, bold radial composition, no people near her.

piercing_wail.name: Piercing Wail
piercing_wail.scene: She cups one hand beside her mouth and sends out three bold concentric rings of sound, cracked grey wall behind and enemy silhouettes recoiling at the edges.

crippling_cloud.name: Crippling Cloud
crippling_cloud.scene: She smashes a vial at an enemy silhouette's feet and a billowing flat acid-green cloud rolls up around the legs, she steps back with a covered scarf, hard shadow cut.

deadly_poison.name: Deadly Poison
deadly_poison.scene: Close-up of her long fingers (jade snake ring visible) dipping a dagger tip into a small vial, a single acid-green drop falling, her half-shadowed eyes in the corner.

poisoned_stab.name: Poisoned Stab
poisoned_stab.scene: Low angle thrust: a dagger dripping bright acid-green poison driven forward toward the camera, her slit-pupil eyes watching over it, flat cel colour.

dagger_spray.name: Dagger Spray
dagger_spray.scene: She sweeps both arms outward and three daggers fan out in a spray like a folding fan, wide arc, long limbs, a cobalt-teal flat sky behind.

backflip.name: Backflip
backflip.scene: Low camera angle on her mid backflip, upside-down tilted head, cloak and scarf trailing in simple shapes, long legs tucked, cloudless sky.

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.scene: She vaults over a white railing with one hand on the bar, long legs scissoring, a few drawn cards fluttering behind, white geometric architecture against the sky.

skewer.name: Skewer
skewer.scene: She lunges with both daggers pointing along one strong diagonal line toward a target silhouette that is impaled on the line, deadpan face, low camera.

blade_dance.name: Blade Dance
blade_dance.scene: She turns in a slow dance inside a circle of three floating shivs that orbit her like a mobile, arms long and elegant, high angle, one flat hot panel behind.

cloak_and_dagger.name: Cloak and Dagger
cloak_and_dagger.scene: She wraps her long green cloak across her body as a shield while one dagger glints out of its folds, head tilted under the hood.

sneaky_strike.name: Sneaky Strike
sneaky_strike.scene: She steps out of a hard black shadow polygon behind an unsuspecting guard silhouette, dagger raised, finger to her lips, tilted head.

terror.name: Terror
terror.scene: High camera looking down at a cowering enemy silhouette while she looms from below the frame with huge acid-green slit-pupil eyes glowing, a stark flat shadow cut.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.scene: She stands directly behind an enemy silhouette and drives a dagger into its back, the foe arching and its head thrown back, hard diagonal shadow cut, no gore.

predator.name: Predator
predator.scene: She prowls low along a ledge like a cat, shoulders down, eyes fixed on prey, long limbs, seen from a high angle with white geometric architecture.

leg_sweep.name: Leg Sweep
leg_sweep.scene: A long low leg sweep arcs across the floor in a flat circle motion line while an enemy silhouette topples backwards, she balances on one hand, seen side-on from a high camera.

slice.name: Slice
slice.scene: One decisive diagonal dagger slice drawing a bright thin white arc across the whole frame, she is a long dark diagonal silhouette behind it.

deflect.name: Deflect
deflect.scene: She bats a thrown dagger aside with her own blade, small flat white stars of sparks, a close tilted face with one sharp eye in the corner.

dodge_and_roll.name: Dodge and Roll
dodge_and_roll.scene: She tumbles in a low forward roll under a swinging spear that cuts the air where she stood, motion arcs, long limbs, flat floor.

bane.name: Bane
bane.scene: She drives a dagger into an already poisoned enemy silhouette, thin green veins of poison spreading across it like branching lines, calm face, shadow cut.

catalyst.name: Catalyst
catalyst.scene: Her hands crush a vial into a flask and a small green gas puff splits into two large clouds, close shot on long fingers and the jade snake ring.

flechettes.name: Flechettes
flechettes.scene: She flicks a fan of slim needle flechettes from her fingertips toward the camera in thin parallel lines, hand large in the foreground, low angle.

adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
adrenaline.scene: She tilts a small vial to her lips, a bright burst of acid-green light flashes behind her and flat speed lines radiate, her eyes wide with slit pupils.

grand_finale.name: Grand Finale
grand_finale.scene: High angle: she stands calm at the centre of a hall of scattered daggers all pointing at one point, the last dagger flying in, many thin white slashes forming a star across the frame.

a_thousand_cuts.name: A Thousand Cuts
a_thousand_cuts.scene: She stands deadpan at the centre of a flat circular field of countless thin white slash lines converging around her, emblem composition with calm margins.

malaise.name: Malaise
malaise.scene: She exhales a sickly green mist over an enemy silhouette that wilts and sags, drooping posture, she holds her scarf over her mouth, hard shadow cut.

burst.name: Burst
burst.scene: Two overlapping poses of her casting the same move, an echo twin offset by a few degrees, flat graphic doubling, a snap of her fingers in the centre.

bullet_time.name: Bullet Time
bullet_time.scene: She stands calm and tilted while a ring of thrown daggers hangs frozen in the air around her at slow spaced intervals, an enemy silhouette far away, cloudless sky.

corpse_explosion.name: Corpse Explosion
corpse_explosion.scene: A slain enemy silhouette bursts into a flat white-and-green blast of shards behind her as she walks away without looking back, low angle.

doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
doppelganger.scene: She faces her own mirror twin, one in dark green and one inverted in bone white, mirrored composition, hands almost touching, a hot flat panel between them.

blur.name: Blur
blur.scene: She dissolves into three horizontal-slice motion copies of herself sliding sideways, each slightly offset, flat speed stripes, dagger in hand.

setup.name: Setup
setup.scene: High angle: she tucks a dagger into her boot top while planning, a single card tucked in her cloak, a tilted pensive head, bright floor geometry.

all_out_attack.name: All-Out Attack
all_out_attack.scene: She flings a huge spray of daggers outward in a low wide sweep covering the whole frame, cloak flaring, low camera, dynamic diagonals.

expertise.name: Expertise
expertise.scene: Close shot on her long fingers handling five daggers and a vial with practiced ease, a half-smile hint, the jade snake ring prominent.

calculated_gamble.name: Calculated Gamble
calculated_gamble.scene: She tosses a small die high into the air with a deadpan tilted face, the die at the top of its arc, cloudless sky and white geometry.

reflex.name: Reflex
reflex.scene: She catches a thrown dagger by its handle an inch from her face, one wide acid-green eye in the frame, tight close-up.

tactician.name: Tactician
tactician.scene: She studies a small tabletop of tiny carved pieces from above with a sidelong glance and a card held in her fingers, pointed chin, classroom-style shadow cut.

after_image.name: After Image
after_image.scene: Emblem composition: three flat ghostly copies of her stepping in the same stance in a staggered row behind the solid heroine, fading in tone, calm margins.

escape_plan.name: Escape Plan
escape_plan.scene: She runs along a rooftop edge, a smoke vial dropping and bursting behind her, a long diagonal composition against a cloudless sky.

finisher.name: Finisher
finisher.scene: She delivers a final stab as the enemy silhouette crumples, a row of tiny slash marks on the wall behind showing the earlier hits, low camera.

masterful_stab.name: Masterful Stab
masterful_stab.scene: Close-up of a dagger point touching one glowing weak spot on a silhouette, her long fingers precise, her slit eyes reflected in the blade.

outmaneuver.name: Outmaneuver
outmaneuver.scene: She slips neatly aside past a charging heavy silhouette in a graceful step, hood tilted, flat floor and diagonal shadows.

accuracy.name: Accuracy
accuracy.scene: Emblem composition: she aims a thin dagger, concentric target rings and thin sight lines converging precisely on its tip, calm centred pose.

choke.name: Choke
choke.scene: A taut thin wire stretched between her gloved hands behind a struggling enemy silhouette, non-graphic, her face calm over the shoulder, shadow cut.

footwork.name: Footwork
footwork.scene: Low angle close-up of her wrapped boot stepping lightly on a stone ledge, other leg long behind, dust puff as flat shapes, cloudless sky.

well_laid_plans.name: Well-Laid Plans
well_laid_plans.scene: Emblem composition: she sits calmly at a table laid out with daggers and vials in a perfect row, one card tucked away in her cloak.

infinite_blades.name: Infinite Blades
infinite_blades.scene: A spiral of floating daggers emerging one after another from her open palm into an endless coil, centred emblem, calm margins.

noxious_fumes.name: Noxious Fumes
noxious_fumes.scene: She stands poised as green fumes curl up from the vials on her bandolier around her, flat spiral shapes, symmetric emblem composition.

envenom.name: Envenom
envenom.scene: Symmetric emblem composition: one dagger with a bead of acid-green poison hanging from its tip, a row of vials above it, her eyes in the corner.

wraith_form.name: Wraith Form
wraith_form.scene: She turns translucent, a ghostly pale green outline floating just above the floor, her cloak dissolving into mist, calm face, high contrast, emblem composition.

tools_of_the_trade.name: Tools of the Trade
tools_of_the_trade.scene: A rolled-out leather kit holding daggers, vials and the jade snake ring, her long fingers drawing one tool, high angle, emblem composition.

bouncing_flask.name: Bouncing Flask
bouncing_flask.scene: A poison flask bounces between two walls along a dotted path, three flat green splashes, she stands at the corner with her arm extended.

concentrate.name: Concentrate
concentrate.scene: She stands with eyes narrowed and one vial held under her nose, quiet breathing, discarded cards falling from her other hand, shadow cut.

distraction.name: Distraction
distraction.scene: Emblem composition: she flicks a coin aside while an enemy silhouette turns its head, and slides out of the opposite side of the frame.

storm_of_steel.name: Storm of Steel
storm_of_steel.scene: A storm of thrown blades radiates from her as she crouches low with arms wide, low camera, radial diagonal composition.

unload.name: Unload
unload.scene: She empties her whole bandolier in a rapid line of thrown knives across the frame on one tight diagonal, her arm sweeping, a hot flat panel behind.
